title: Higgsfield AI + ChatGPT = Full Marketing Campaign in Minutes!
description:
Build a full marketing campaign by texting Higgsfield AI inside ChatGPT. Generate professional video assets in seconds.

This workflow allows you to handle urgent creative requests without leaving your chat window. It is built for marketers who need to turn a text prompt into a complete commercial video while on the go.

The Higgsfield AI integration functions just like texting a colleague. By using the ChatGPT plugin, you can request specific video styles and receive results instantly, streamlining your AI video generation process. It is the fastest way to execute a marketing campaign when you are nowhere near your desk.

Subscribe for weekly AI workflow breakdowns, and let me know in the comments if you want to see a specific video style generated next.
